wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2020–21 |team=North Alabama Lions |image=North Alabama Lions wordmark.svg |image_size= 250 |conference=Atlantic Sun Conference |division= |short_conf=ASUN |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=13–11 |conf_record=7–8 |head_coach=[[Tony Pujol]] |hc_year=3rd |asst_coach1=Ahmad Smith |asst_coach2=Willie Watson |asst_coach3=Tom Berryman |stadium=[[Flowers Hall]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2020–21 Atlantic Sun men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Alabama]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Lions, led by third-year head coach [[Tony Pujol]], played their home games at [[Flowers Hall]] in [[Florence, Alabama]], as members of the [[Atlantic Sun Conference]] (ASUN). This season marked North Alabama's third of a four-year transition period from [[NCAA Division II|Division II]] to [[NCAA Division I|Division I]]. As a result, the Lions are not eligible for NCAA postseason play, but could participate in the [[2021 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]]. They were also eligible to play in the [[College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] tournament, but not invited. They finished the season 13–11, 7–8 in [[2020–21 ASUN Conference men's basketball season|ASUN Play]] to finish in 5th place. They defeated [[2020–21 North Florida Ospreys men's basketball team|North Florida]] and [[2020–21 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]] to advance to the championship game of the [[2021 ASUN men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]] where they lost to [[2020–21 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 North Alabama Lions men's basketball team|Lions]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 13–17, 8–8 in ASUN play, to finish in fifth place in the conference. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]] to [[2019–20 Stetson Hatters men's basketball team|Stetson]].{{Cite
